name: CSV
description: Fetches records from a remote CSV file over HTTP/HTTPS. Supports custom delimiters, optional header rows, and authenticated endpoints via bearer token.
author: OnePlatform

url.description: URL to fetch the CSV file from (http:// or https://).

delimiter.description: Field delimiter character. Defaults to comma.

hasHeader.description: When true, the first row is treated as a header row and provides field names.

encoding.description: Character encoding of the CSV file.

idColumn.description: Column name to use as sourceId. When omitted, the row index is used.

batchSize.description: Number of records to return per fetchBatch call.

requiredCredentials.name: bearerToken
requiredCredentials.description: Bearer token for authenticated CSV endpoints. Optional — omit if the URL is publicly accessible.
